mapper.update: UPDATE time_slots SET current_examiners = #{currentExaminers}, booked_sessions = #{bookedSessions}, status = CASE WHEN #{currentExaminers} >= required_examiners THEN 'full' WHEN #{currentExaminers} > 0 THEN 'partial' ELSE 'empty' END, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE slot_id = #{slotId}
